description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Horizon3 is seeking an Analyst Relations Director to own and advance our complete analyst relations strategy. This is a strategically important individual-contributor role for an experienced operator who can build trusted relationships with industry analysts, shape how Horizon3 is understood in the market, and turn analyst insight into better go-to-market and product decisions.

You will partner closely with leaders across Product Marketing, Product Management, and the executive leadership team. You will help analysts understand Horizon3’s capabilities, customer outcomes, product direction, and point of view; coordinate high-quality briefings and inquiries; and use market intelligence to strengthen our positioning, product strategy, and commercial execution.

Location: San Francisco Bay Area

What You’ll Do

Own the analyst relations strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive analyst relations strategy aligned to Horizon3’s business priorities, product direction, market opportunities, and go-to-market plans.

  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, operating rhythms, and measures for the analyst relations program.

  • Determine where analyst engagement can create the greatest leverage across corporate reputation, product adoption, category leadership, competitive differentiation, and market education.

  • Build repeatable processes for planning, briefing preparation, inquiry management, follow-up, internal alignment, and insight distribution.

Build trusted analyst relationships

  • Develop durable, credible relationships with analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and other relevant firms.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact who can provide timely, accurate, and useful context about Horizon3, its customers, its market, and its perspective.

  • Identify the analysts, research agendas, evaluations, events, and conversations most relevant to Horizon3’s priorities.

  • Create productive two-way relationships rather than treating analyst engagement as a series of one-way briefings.

Lead briefings, inquiries, and market engagement

  • Plan and lead analyst briefings that clearly communicate Horizon3’s current capabilities, differentiation, customer success stories, business value, and approved future roadmap direction.

  • Prepare executives, product leaders, product marketers, and customer participants to deliver focused, evidence-based conversations.

  • Manage analyst inquiries with rigor, coordinating the right internal experts and ensuring responses are clear, consistent, technically credible, and appropriately supported.

  • Translate complex product and security concepts into narratives that are relevant to analysts and the buyers they influence.

  • Capture follow-up questions, points of uncertainty, and areas where Horizon3 needs stronger proof, clarity, or market education.

Turn analyst insight into business advantage

  • Conduct structured inquiries and synthesize analyst perspectives into actionable market intelligence.

  • Identify shifts in buyer priorities, category definitions, competitive dynamics, evaluation criteria, and emerging market needs.

  • Share concise, decision-ready insights with Product Marketing, Product Management, executive leadership, and other relevant partners.

  • Help inform go-to-market strategy, positioning, messaging, launch priorities, content strategy, and product roadmap discussions without taking ownership of the product roadmap itself.

  • Build feedback loops that connect analyst insight with customer evidence, field feedback, win-loss learning, and product truth.

Strengthen category position and market influence

  • Help Horizon3 improve its performance, visibility, and positioning in relevant analyst evaluations and market categories.

  • Develop the evidence, narratives, customer proof, and internal readiness needed to present Horizon3’s value clearly and credibly.

  • Identify opportunities to create, evolve, or enhance market categories where Horizon3 can establish a differentiated point of view.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and executive leadership to articulate the market problem Horizon3 is solving, why existing approaches fall short, and how the company’s approach changes the outcome for customers.

  • Support a coherent company and portfolio narrative across analyst conversations, customer proof, executive communications, and go-to-market programs.

Create leverage across the organization

  • Lead across functions through preparation, clarity, sound judgment, and follow-through rather than formal authority.

  • Establish standards for analyst-facing content, briefing materials, narratives, proof points, and response quality.

  • Maintain a reliable source of truth for analyst interactions, commitments, feedback, research, and next actions.

  • Work with enablement and GTM on how to best use the analysts to shorten sales cycles, drive engagement, drive advocacy and reviews, and promote thought leadership.

  • Help teams stay close to product details, customer outcomes, competitive context, and the questions that matter most in the market.

  • Measure program effectiveness through meaningful indicators such as relationship strength, quality and usefulness of insight, engagement with priority firms, evaluation outcomes, market visibility, and influence on business decisions.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years experience leading analyst relations for a B2B technology or cybersecurity company.

  • Established relationships with analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and/or comparable industry research firms.

  • Experience shaping market categories and influencing go-to-market and product strategy through market intelligence.

  • Strong understanding of the analyst relations discipline, including briefings, inquiries, research agendas, evaluations, customer references, and executive preparation.

  • The ability to understand complex technology and translate product capabilities, customer evidence, and market dynamics into clear, differentiated narratives.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to tailor a message for analysts, executives, product leaders, and customer audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional programs as an individual contributor.

  • Strong program management, organization, and follow-through across multiple firms, priorities, and timelines.

  • A high standard for accuracy, confidentiality, preparation, and factual integrity.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in enterprise cybersecurity, cloud security, identity, exposure management, security operations, or a related market.

  • Experience supporting or influencing analyst evaluations, market guides, waves, magic quadrants, landscapes, or similar research formats.

  • Experience helping establish or redefine an emerging technology category.

  • Experience developing customer proof programs or incorporating customer executives and practitioners into analyst engagement.

  • Familiarity with an AI-native or rapidly evolving technology market.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strategic ownership: You can set the direction for a complete analyst relations program and connect daily execution to company-level outcomes.

  • Commercial judgment: You understand how analyst perspectives affect buyer understanding, competitive differentiation, pipeline, adoption, and long-term market position.

  • Credibility and curiosity: You ask precise questions, learn the product and customer reality deeply, and earn trust by being useful and accurate.

  • Executive presence: You can prepare leaders for consequential conversations, facilitate productive discussions, and communicate difficult or incomplete information clearly.

  • Cross-functional influence: You can align Product Marketing, Product Management, executives, Sales, Customer Success, and other partners around a shared narrative and coordinated action.

  • High-agency execution: You diagnose what is needed, create the plan, drive the work, and close the loop without waiting for continuous direction.

  • Evidence-oriented thinking: You distinguish market signal from opinion and build narratives around customer outcomes, product truth, and credible proof.

  • Craftsmanship and urgency: You care about the details, stay close to the actual work, and raise the quality of every analyst interaction and internal decision it informs.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $209,000 - $274,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
